verdict.rationale: Typesense is explicitly open-source and self-hostable via Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Homebrew, binaries, DEB/RPM packages, and Terraform modules, with the same core feature set (search, filtering, faceting, ranking, semantic/hybrid search) documented for self-hosted use, and Typesense Cloud is described as 'the hosted SaaS version of our Open Source product,' implying feature parity. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that self-hosted clusters achieve full parity with Cloud-only operational features (e.g., Search Delivery Network, GPU acceleration, HA tooling) rather than just vendor claims.
